annotations.title: Send a pipeline tool a test run

description: Sends one AI tool on provider external (a pipeline — your own server runs it) a test run: every declared input gets a placeholder value, and Gemmein signs and posts the hand-off to the tool's own URL, the same way a real run would. Answers acknowledged, completed, failed or timeout, with the ms each step took. Costs no credits and holds nothing — it is never a real run. Refused (tool_incomplete) with no URL or no signing secret set yet (rotate one with the dashboard, or ai tools rotate-secret). Development only. On the founder's Logs.
name: test_run_ai_tool
